title: Final Vacancy Notice Corporate Finance And Policy Manager (002)
text:
VACANCY NOTICE
The Securities and Exchange Commission of Zimbabwe is inviting applications from
suitably qualified and experienced candidates to fill the position of Corporate Finance
and Policy Manager in the Policy and Market Development Department.
Core Competencies:
• Knowledge of Corporate Finance and issuer regulation.
• Strategic Leadership and Analytical Thinking.
• Policy Formulation, Review, and Implementation.
• Research and fintech appreciation
• Risk Management and Compliance Oversight.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Duties and Responsibilities:
• Developing, implementing, and maintaining relevant market policies,
procedures, and guidelines in line with regulatory requirements and industry
best practices.
• Reviewing all corporate actions filed with the Commission and ensuring
compliance with issuer disclosure requirements for investor protection.
• Analyzing disclosures by listed companies and providing insights to inform
regulatory decisions by the Commission.
• Managing the Commission’s enterprise risk management through robust risk
management strategies.
• Leading the Commission fintech engagements and regulatory sandbox testing to
promote market development
• Conducting relevant market research and analysing economic developments to
inform policy and legislative proposals.
• Leading the Commission’s market development initiatives to align with
international trends.
• Identifying market development gaps to inform regulatory changes and policy
formulation.
• Fostering local and regional regulatory collaboration

Requisite qualifications & experience:
• Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, Law, Banking, or
equivalent.
• Master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Banking or related fields.
• Relevant professional qualification is an added advantage.
• Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in corporate finance, investment or
merchant banking, capital markets, or a related investments environment.
Application letters with C.V.s to be addressed to the Human Resources Manager and
e-mailed to recruitment@seczim.co.zw with the position being applied for clearly
stated in the email subject by 13 February 2026. N/B Only shortlisted candidates will
be responded to.
